chapters.label: Where I'm from
chapters.text: Manado, Indonesia. A village kid from a place with almost no footprint in the rooms I work in now. First time accessing internet in 2011. Only started learning English properly in 2018. Put myself through a small unknown university. Then 'merantau': left home to find what's next. None of my peers made it abroad. Most married young. If others were born way ahead, I just run my race at my own pace.

chapters.label: The business side
chapters.text: I started as the stakeholder who needed bankers, not the HR staff doing paperwork. I kept getting pulled into the same mess: a process has grown, information is scattered, and the team spends its time chasing updates instead of making decisions. I trace where the work breaks, rebuild the flow, and leave behind a system people can keep using.

chapters.label: Why analytics
chapters.text: I did the MBA in Analytics to gain the language for problems I was already solving. Generalist background, technical fluency on purpose.

chapters.label: How I think
chapters.text: ENTP-T. A little bit of everything. I connect ideas, spot patterns, and make sense of messy situations. Then I need the practical how, not generic shoulds. Elegant frameworks make me suspicious. I cross-check every model against lived experience. I have to build the vehicle before I drive it.

chapters.label: How I lead
chapters.text: I'm a king-maker, or trying to be: I want the people around me to feel more capable than they did yesterday. Leading from behind.

detail: Building a people-analytics portfolio in public, and shipping the tools I build along the way.
Built difficulty-weighted KPI scorecards for 15 recruiters across six regions. Fair measurement where the hiring was hardest.
Joined intake, exit interview, performance and training records into one view of frontline attrition. It contributed to department turnover falling about 15% in 2023 and 17% in 2024.
Built a referral anti-gaming system my successors ran and extended for 12+ months after I left.
Cut hiring SLA 80% and recruiter admin workload 60% by replacing scattered intake with a single gate handling 10,000+ CVs a year.
Recruiters stopped retyping and started deciding.
Lifted merchant acquisitions 40% with a real-time dashboard across field sales and partnerships.
One shared view of the field, instead of everyone running their own numbers.
Standardized sales workflows in Odoo across 7 subsidiaries.
Market entry for a cosmetics line.
3-week, 3-country tour. Gold Medal at Canta al Mar, Spain.
Finances and payroll for 100+ construction workers, plus vendor contracts.
